scope: All units read: text for sense, translation and word glosses against the text. The text was not compared with the source page.

items.issue: ariṣṭanemi (“of unbroken felly”) was rendered “averter of harm”.
items.change: Now “Tārkṣya of the unbroken felly”, as in the word gloss.

items.issue: tvattas tiṣṭhati (ablative) was rendered “abides in you”.
varṇādi, “the first of the letters”, is a; the translation said “the letter that follows (ṇa)”, which contradicted its own next sentence and the mantra gaṃ.
items.change: Now “then the first of the letters (‘a’)”.
Respaced as “sa sarvavighnairna bādhyate”; no letter changed.

items.issue: The page reads brahmādyācaraṇaṃ vidyāt (“one should know the practice beginning with Brahmā”). Many recensions read brahmādyāvaraṇaṃ (“the covering, i.e. protection, of Brahmā and the rest”). Both are transmitted; the sense differs.
options: A. Keep ācaraṇaṃ as the source has it.
B. Change to āvaraṇaṃ and retranslate.
C. Keep, and mention the other reading in the translation.
items.recommend: A or C; this is a real variant, not a slip.
